summary: The current implementation satisfies the saved P0 merge-safety regression plan. Production code blocks post-PR ready rows without an active recovery discriminator via PR_REEXECUTION_GUARD, validate-only and rebase-only recovery paths skip full agent execution and return to monitoring_pr or completed, PR monitor dispatch creates observable recovery operations/events before ready step-backs, remonitor stays in monitoring_pr and routes through resume_pr_monitor, and stale/rebase recovery performs Tier 2 validation without PR recreation. Validation passed: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev pytest tests/unit/control tests/unit/runtime -q; uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev ruff check src/awf tests; uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev mypy src/awf.
